title_ar: وجوب الاستسلام لما جاء به الوحي
title_en: The Obligation to Submit to What Revelation Has Brought
body_ar: إن الحمد لله نحمده و نستعينه و نعوذ بالله من شرور أنفسنا و من سيئات أعمالنا من يهده الله فلا مضل له و من يضلل فلا هادي له و أشهد أن لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له و أشهد أن محمدا عبده و رسوله صلى الله عليه و على آله و أصحابه و سلم تسليما كثيرا. ﴿يأيها الناس اتقوا ربكم الذي خلقكم من نفس واحدة و خلق منها زوجها و بث منهما رجالا كثيرا و نساء و اتقوا الله الذي تساءلون به و الأرحام إن الله كان عليكم رقيبا﴾ ﴿يأيها الذين آمنوا اتقوا الله و قولوا قولا سديدا يصلح لكم أعمالكم و يغفر لكم ذنوبكم و من يطع الله و رسوله فقد فاز فوزا عظيما﴾ أما بعد فإن خير الهدي هدي محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم و شر الأمور محدثاتها و كل بدعة ضلالة و إن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قد أمره الله بالإقتداء بهدي الأنبياء من قبله و أمرنا نحن بالإقتداء بهديه هو صلى الله عليه وسلم فقال تعالى: ﴿فبهداهم اقتده﴾ و قال تعالى: ﴿لقد كان لكم في رسول الله إسوة حسنة﴾ و قد حذر رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم من الإقتداء بالمشركين و من إتباع آثار اليهود و النصارى
body_en:
Praise belongs to God. We praise Him, we seek His help, and we seek refuge in God from the evils of our own selves and from the evil consequences of our deeds. Whomever God guides, none can lead astray; and whomever He leads astray, none can guide. I bear witness that there is no god but God alone, who has no partner, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and His Messenger — may God's blessings be upon him and upon his family and his Companions, and may He grant them abundant peace.

{O people, be mindful of your Lord, who created you from a single soul and created from it its mate, and from the two of them spread abroad many men and women. And be mindful of God, in whose name you make requests of one another, and of the ties of kinship. Indeed God is ever watchful over you} (Sūrat al-Nisāʾ 4:1).

{O you who believe, be mindful of God and speak words that are apt. He will set your deeds right for you and forgive you your sins. And whoever obeys God and His Messenger has attained a great triumph} (Sūrat al-Aḥzāb 33:70–71).

To proceed: the best guidance is the guidance of Muhammad (peace and blessings be upon him), and the worst of affairs are the newly invented ones, and every innovation in religion (bidʿah) is an error. God commanded the Messenger of God (peace and blessings be upon him) to take as his model the guidance of the prophets before him, and He commanded us to take as our model his own guidance (peace and blessings be upon him). God Most High said: {so follow their guidance} (Sūrat al-Anʿām 6:90), and God Most High said: {you have indeed in the Messenger of God an excellent model} (Sūrat al-Aḥzāb 33:21). And the Messenger of God (peace and blessings be upon him) warned against taking the idolaters as a model and against following in the tracks of the Jews and the Christians

flags.note: The page stops here, with no predicate, no punctuation and no evidence for the warning. The sermon's announced subject — the obligation to submit to revelation — is never argued. Critical for display: the last thing a reader sees is a warning against resembling non-Muslims, with none of the Sheikh's qualification or reasoning, which is exactly the kind of fragment that reads as a ruling when it is not one.

flags.note: wujūb here is the ordinary legal sense (obligation), since its subject is a human act of submission, not a proposition about God; the creedal sense of wājib does not apply. The body of the sermon is not present, so the reading rests on the title alone.

translator_notes: Qur'anic renderings here are interpretive and are not a substitute for the Arabic.

The published page carries only the opening of this sermon — the khuṭbat al-ḥājah, the three customary verses and the first two sentences of the address — and then breaks off in mid-clause. The full text is offered on the site as a downloadable Word document. The English ends exactly where the Arabic ends, without a closing full stop, and nothing has been supplied to complete it.
